recent.text: On this day, the New Orleans Pelicans have the dubious distinction of suffering their worst regular season loss in franchise history, a 138-87 loss to the Golden State Warriors. It eclipses a 49-point (153-104) defeat the Heat several seasons ago (4/11/2025).
recent.author: Oleh Kosel 🇺🇦🇺🇸🇦🇺

recent.text: This is Jordan Poole's first game action since Oct. 28 vs. Nuggets (he was injured that night). #Pelicans bench outscored the opposing subs in each of the first nine games of this season, a streak that finally ended last night at Clippers

recent.text: Clippers ride big offensive night, with 35-plus pts in final three quarters, to hand #Pelicans a rare convincing loss, by 139-123 margin. Trey Murphy 26 pts to lead New Orleans; Jeremiah Fears and Zion Williamson 25 pts each. Postgame wrap: https://t.co/xkErOvebE7 https://t.co/fsDEIcgEeL
recent.author: Jim Eichenhofer

recent.text: Pelicans fall 139-123 to Clippers. Team had nice run out of halftime, grabbing 86-82 w/ 5:20 left in 3RD QTR but all downhill after that. Defense was atrocious -- gave up 35+ points in last three frames. Offense failed w/ Zion Williamson not getting appropriate amount of touches.
recent.author: Oleh Kosel 🇺🇦🇺🇸🇦🇺

recent.text: Clippers crowd is chanting "We want DJ!" to see LAC legend and former All-Star center DeAndre Jordan check into the game, but like many deep-career veterans, he does not enter late in these situations with outcome decided

recent.text: Maybe the best combined offensive game for Murphy (19 pts), Williamson (21) and Fears (19) of the young season. They have not all scored 20+ on the same night yet among the first nine games (came close vs. Kings when Murphy had 19, the others had 22 and 22)
